description: Source code for a web worker that manages loading and executing Python code via pyodide in a browser environment, including message handling, pyodide setup, and error management.

methods.name: setupPyodide
methods.description: Initializes pyodide environment, loads necessary files, and sets up the worker state.

methods.name: resetPyodide
methods.description: Resets the pyodide environment by reinitializing it.

methods.name: initRunPython
methods.description: Prepares the pyodide environment for executing Python code, including setting up custom input/output functions and exception handling.

methods.name: handleListenRequest
methods.description: Handles 'listen' message to enable message processing.

methods.name: handleRunRequest
methods.description: Executes provided Python code within pyodide, manages exceptions, and communicates results.

methods.name: handleCancelRequest
methods.description: Handles cancellation requests, informing the client.
